about.value:
Xingtai GuXiao Rubber Products Co., Ltd. is a professional automotive rubber parts manufacturer , specializing in the production of high-quality rubber components for steering systems, suspension systems, drivetrain systems, engine sealing systems, and hydraulic applications .

Located in Tiankou Town, Renxian County, Xingtai City, Hebei Province, China, our factory focuses on precision manufacturing of critical rubber parts such as CV Joint Boots, Driveshaft Boots, Steering Rack Boots, Shock Absorber Boots, Stabilizer Bar Bushings, Rubber O-Rings, and Valve Cover Gaskets .

With in-depth experience in OEM & ODM custom rubber parts manufacturing , we provide both standard automotive rubber components and fully customized solutions based on drawings, samples, or application requirements.

Our products are widely used for oil leak prevention, dust protection, sealing performance enhancement, and NVH reduction , helping improve vehicle reliability and service life under harsh operating conditions.

faqs.title: What automotive rubber parts do you manufacture?
faqs.content: We manufacture a wide range of automotive rubber parts including CV Joint Boots, Driveshaft Boots, Steering Rack Boots, Shock Absorber Boots, Stabilizer Bar Bushings, Rubber O-Rings, Valve Cover Gaskets , and other custom rubber sealing components.

faqs.title: Which vehicle systems are your rubber parts used for?
faqs.content: Our rubber parts are mainly used in steering systems, suspension systems, drivetrain systems, engine sealing systems, and hydraulic systems , providing sealing, dust protection, vibration reduction, and oil leak prevention.

faqs.title: Do you support OEM and ODM rubber parts manufacturing?
faqs.content: Yes. We provide complete OEM & ODM rubber manufacturing services , including product design support, rubber material selection, mold development, sample testing, and stable mass production.

faqs.title: Can you produce custom rubber parts based on drawings or samples?
faqs.content: Yes. We support custom rubber parts manufacturing based on 2D / 3D drawings, physical samples, or application requirements , and offer technical optimization to improve sealing performance and service life.

faqs.title: Which rubber materials do you use?
faqs.content: We mainly use NBR, Viton (FKM), Silicone, and ACM rubber materials , selected according to oil resistance, heat resistance, chemical exposure, and operating environment requirements.

faqs.title: How do you ensure the quality of automotive rubber parts?
faqs.content: We implement strict quality control throughout the production process, from raw material inspection and molding control to final dimensional and performance inspection, ensuring OEM-level quality consistency.

faqs.title: Are your rubber parts suitable for aftermarket and OEM supply?
faqs.content: Yes. Our rubber parts are supplied to both OEM manufacturers and automotive aftermarket distributors , suitable for original equipment, replacement, and export markets.

faqs.title: How can I start cooperation or request a quotation?
faqs.content: You can contact us via our OEM inquiry form or request a quote by submitting drawings, samples, application details, and estimated order quantity. Our team will respond promptly with technical and commercial support.
